title: The Portrait of Old Chapel Road
author: Sable Vasquez
blurb: Ivo Yarrow, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
